en.name: Mystic Regeneration
en.description: For 5...20 seconds, you have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.
en.concise: (5...20 seconds.) You have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.

fr.name: Régénération mystique
